notes: Phase 57, the first video recipe. Four facts were read out of the pinned diffusers==0.36.0 wheel and this repo's own configs rather than guessed, because each one produces a plausible non-failure when it is wrong. (a) THE VAE LOADS SEPARATELY IN FLOAT32 while the transformer is bfloat16 — upstream's own example does AutoencoderKLWan.from_pretrained(repo, subfolder='vae', torch_dtype=torch.float32) and passes it in; a uniform bf16 load is not an error, it is the difference between a video and noise, discovered four minutes into a job. (b) HEIGHT AND WIDTH MUST BE MULTIPLES OF 16 (WanPipeline.check_inputs) where every image pipeline this project ships downsamples by 8, and num_frames sits on a 4k+1 grid because prepare_latents computes (num_frames - 1) // 4 + 1 latent frames against a temporal scale factor of 4 (vae config temperal_downsample = [false, true, true]). (c) flow_shift IS A SCHEDULER SETTING, NOT A CALL ARGUMENT — and THIS repo already ships flow_shift: 3.0 in scheduler/scheduler_config.json, which is the 480p value; upstream's example sets it by hand because it is written for the 14B 720p model, where 5.0 is wanted. The field below therefore matches the checked-in config and the worker only overrides when a recipe names one. (d) '1.3B' NAMES THE TRANSFORMER ONLY. The text encoder is UMT5-XXL at ~11B, and every weight in this repo is stored fp32 with NO fp16/bf16 variant — so the download is ~29 GB and the resident bf16 footprint is dominated by the encoder, not by the DiT. That is the v3.14.1 variant-is-not-dtype lesson in the one shape where there is nothing to fix: there is no variant to ask for, so torch_dtype does the cast and the disk cost is unavoidable. vramMiB below WAS sized from that arithmetic and is now MEASURED (phase 60): on a 3090 Ti one 832x480 five-second clip peaked at 18540 MiB with a ~850 MiB baseline from other processes on the card, so the model's own peak is ~17700 and 18000 is that plus a small margin. The old 15500 was low. UNTILED IT PEAKED AT 24287 MiB AND NEVER FINISHED: the decode materialises all 81 frames at once, spilled to system memory and burned more than 22 minutes without producing bytes, three times. vaeTiling above is what phase 58 D3 built for exactly that and was set on cogvideox-2b and wan-t2v-14b-720p but not on this recipe, which predates the field.
